items.definition: to produce tears from your eyes.
to play piano many times to get better.
items.example: I practise the piano every day.

items.definition: to make a loud sound like a dog.
to have parties with very loud sounds and people.
items.example: They have noisy parties on weekends.

items.definition: to make very strong sound from music.
items.example: He plays loud music in his room.

items.definition: to talk with anger many times together.
items.example: They argue a lot every day.

items.definition: The television is playing and showing pictures.
items.example: I have the TV on now.

items.definition: To produce very loud or many sounds.
items.example: The children make a lot of noise.

items.definition: A person who lives near you.
